scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm run build -w @powerotp/gate-core && npm run build -w @powerotp/gate-node && npm run build -w @powerotp/gate-express -w @powerotp/gate-next -w @powerotp/server-sdk -w @powerotp/widget-loader && npm run build -w @powerotp/telephony-agent
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm run lint:root
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test && npm run test:root
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm run typecheck:root
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run lint && npm run test
